headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of September 1, 2026, the portfolio has achieved an average return of 25.10%, significantly outperforming the SPY benchmark return of 12.41%. This outperformance translates to an average alpha of 12.69%, indicating that the portfolio is not only growing in absolute terms but is also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has delivered an impressive return of 47.67%, contributing positively to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', has returned 11.36%, which is still above the benchmark but less robust compared to the top performer. This relative strength against SPY is particularly notable during periods of market volatility and uncertainty. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
